messages:
Alana: Quick design review — Getting Started rail (compact). Need eyes on CTA copy + contrast/a11y. Screenshot in Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz
Meena: Looking now. Noted two things: CTA label options and color contrast on the blue pill. :eyes:
Josh: My instinct: keep CTAs short. 'Try sample project' vs 'Create a sample app' — prefer shorter and action-y.
Tomas: Agree on brevity. Also ran a quick contrast check: current primary blue (#1E90FF) on white fails 4.5:1 for 14px body. It's ~3.2:1.
Meena: Ugh. I tested in Axe too. Small text link on the rail drops under AA.
Alana: Can we swap to solid #0B63D6 for the primary CTA? That should hit ~4.6:1. Also consider bolding the CTA label for token text size increases.
Elana: Accessibility nit — sample thumbnails don't have alt text. They read as empty images to screen readers. Should be explicit like 'Sample: Chat assistant project'.
Tomas: Good catch. Also keyboard focus: when tabbing into the rail the first focus lands on the dismiss icon instead of the primary CTA. Repro: tab to rail, focus order is wrong.
Josh: Repro'd. Proposed quick CSS fix:
```
.rail-cta:focus { outline: 3px solid #ffbf47; outline-offset: 2px; }
.rail-item { tabindex: 0; }
```
That gives visible focus and we can reorder DOM so CTA is first tabbable element.
Meena: For copy variants I mocked three options in Figma:
A) "Try sample project"
B) "Get started with a sample"
C) "Create a sample app"
Which one do we A/B?
Tomas: Leaning B — explicit and reads well with the supporting microcopy.
Alana: B works. Also add a screen-reader-only label on the rail header like "Getting started: sample projects" for context.
Meena: I'll update the figma frames and push a branch with the color swap + alt text + copy B. Will run Lighthouse and paste results here.
Alana: One more UX ask: add a small 'Skip onboarding' link for people who want to dismiss permanently (with accessible aria-controls to manage the preference).
Elana: +1 on the skip link. And ensure the dismiss control has aria-pressed or similar state.
Josh: I'll pick up the frontend changes tomorrow morning. Pinged #eng-frontend.
devex-bot: Deploy preview created: https://deploy-preview.example.com/getting-started-rail-contrast (branch: getting-started-rail-contrast)
Tomas: Reviewed the preview — focus ring looks good, contrast improved, copy switched to option B. Noted a tiny vertical spacing issue on mobile between the thumbnail and title (6px vs 8px).
Meena: I'll fix the spacing in the next commit and re-run accessibility checks.
Alana: Perfect. If Meena can send the updated preview link here we'll merge after the spacing tweak. Thanks everyone :pray:
